title: Why Shallow Neural Networks Learn Sinusoidal Components First: An Orthogonal Polynomial Dynamics Framework
abstract: arXiv:2610.21964v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Neural networks often learn low-frequency components before high-frequency ones --- a phenomenon called spectral bias or termed F-principle. Many numerical studies have demonstrated this phenomenon, and theoretical studies have sought to explain it. However, several goals remain insufficiently addressed: (1) explaining spectral bias asymptotically, including its origin and why the preferred components are generally sinusoidal; (2) extending the explanation to general activation functions, such as sigmoid and ReLU; (3) making weak assumptions about the data distribution; (4) avoiding aliasing effects, such as those arising in finite-domain Fourier analysis; and (5) developing a theoretical framework applicable to arbitrary networks. translated_title: 为什么浅层神经网络首先学习正弦分量：一个正交多项式动力学框架
translated_abstract: 神经网络通常先学习低频分量、后学习高频分量——这一现象被称为谱偏置或F-原理。许多数值研究已经证实了这一现象，理论研究也尝试对其进行解释。然而，以下几个目标仍未得到充分解决：(1) 渐近地解释谱偏置，包括其起源以及为什么被优先学习的分量通常是正弦的；(2) 将解释推广到一般的激活函数，如sigmoid和ReLU；(3) 对数据分布做较弱的假设；(4) 避免混叠效应，例如有限域傅里叶分析中出现的混叠效应；(5) 发展一个适用于任意网络的理论框架。我们通过分析动力学矩阵H的特征值衰减和特征向量形状，从理论上实现了这些目标——该矩阵在我们将网络输出展开为一般傅里叶级数（GFS）时产生……
tldr: 该论文提出基于一般傅里叶级数展开的正交多项式动力学框架，通过分析动力学矩阵的特征值衰减与特征向量形状，从理论上解释了浅层神经网络为何优先学习正弦（低频）分量的谱偏置现象，并适用于一般激活函数、弱数据分布假设和任意网络结构。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an orthogonal polynomial dynamics framework based on general Fourier series expansion, theoretically explaining spectral bias—why shallow neural networks learn sinusoidal (low-frequency) components first—by analyzing the eigenvalue decay and eigenvector shapes of the dynamics matrix, applicable to general activation functions under weak data distribution assumptions.
